page_data.en:
August 29, 1940.

Re Janus Mark, Hungarian,

From a conversation with Mr. J.J. Ypma,
assistant and acting clerk of the Netherlands
Consulate-General, which, at present is temporarily
in charge of Hungarian interests, it would appear
that the Christian name of Mark is Janus and not
Fanus.

According to Mr. Ypma, Mark appeared before
him with an expired Hungarian passport No.A339088
and requested either an extention for it or a new
one. He was issued with a temporary Netherlands
passport No.N.S. 188 valid for one year on April 2,
1940. He was allowed to keep the old passport for
identification purposes. He stated, and produced
a personal card, that he was manager of the Crystal
Mineral Water Factory in Bangkok and wished to travel
to Japan or North China on business.

Before leaving he requested a loan of money
from Mr. Ypma. This was refused and he was referred
to the Hungarian Relief Association, 209 Yuen Ming
Wuen Road where he also applied but without success.

There, requests for money raised doubts in
the mind of Mr. Ypma as to Mark's genuineness but
since that time he has had no information regarding
Mark.

Mr. P. Komor of the Jewish Immigrants
Association was next interviewed. His information
regarding Mark is as follows :-
page_data.zh:
1940年8月29日。

关于匈牙利人 Janus Mark，

经与荷兰总领事馆助理兼代理书记员 J.J. Ypma 先生交谈获悉，该馆目前暂代管匈牙利利益。据 Ypma 先生称，Mark 的教名是 Janus 而非 Fanus。

据 Ypma 先生称，Mark 持已过期的匈牙利护照（编号 A339088）前来求见，请求延期或换发新照。1940年4月2日，当局向其签发了有效期为一年的荷兰临时护照（编号 N.S. 188）。为便于身份证明，允许其保留旧护照。Mark 自称并出示个人名片，称其为曼谷 Crystal 矿泉水厂经理，拟因公务前往日本或华北地区。

临行前，他曾向 Ypma 先生借款。该请求被拒，并被引荐至圆明园路209号的匈牙利救济协会，他亦向该会提出申请，但未获成功。

因其提出金钱请求，Ypma 先生对 Mark 身份的真实性产生怀疑，但自那以后，未再获得有关 Mark 的任何消息。

随后约谈了犹太移民协会（Jewish Immigrants Association）的 P. Komor 先生。其提供的关于 Mark 的情报如下：-

page_data.en:
- 2 -

Ex-Hungarian Ensign in the army 1914-18.
Prisoner of war in various prison camps
in Siberia.
Resided in Harbin where his reputation was
not good.
Came to Shanghai about 1930 for a few months.
Got into debt. Borrowed money from the
Hungarian Relief Fund but never repaid the loan.
Returned to Harbin.
His activities of late are not known to Mr.
Komor. Should any further information be required,
Mr. Komor suggested that Mr. Van der Hoeven, Hon.-
Consul for the Netherlands, Harbin, be communicated with.
There is nothing in Municipal Police records
concerning Mark but it is known that he left Shanghai
for Dairen on August 24, 1940, giving his Shanghai address
as New Asia Hotel and his occupation as merchant.
page_data.zh:
- 2 -

1914-18年间曾任匈牙利陆军少尉。
曾在西伯利亚各战俘营担任战俘。
曾居住于哈尔滨，声誉不佳。
约于1930年来沪停留数月。
陷入债务困境。曾向匈牙利救济基金借款，但从未偿还。
返回哈尔滨。
Komor 先生不知其近期活动。如需进一步情报，Komor 先生建议联系荷兰驻哈尔滨名誉领事 Van der Hoeven 先生。
工部局警务处档案中无关于 Mark 的记录，但已知其于1940年8月24日离开上海前往大连，其在沪住址登记为新亚酒店（New Asia Hotel），职业登记为商人。

page_data.en:
BRITISH CONSULATE-GENERAL,
SHANGHAL

17th September 1940.

Dear Mr. Yorke,

I understand that sometime in August
enquiries were made at the Netherlands Consulate-General by
the Special Branch regarding Janos MARK, a Hungarian national.
I should be grateful if you would let me
have a copy of your report on this individual. Can you
confirm whether he is at present in Shanghai as I understand
he left Bangkok for Shanghai on or about 27th July last?
The Netherlands Consulate-General has
kindly given us information regarding the issue of the new
passport to Mark.

Yours sincerely,

Passport Control Officer.

R. W. Yorke, Esquire,
Shanghai Municipal Police,
SHANGHAI.

（批：PA 17/9）
page_data.zh:
英国驻上海总领事馆，
上海

1940年9月17日。

亲爱的约克（Yorke）先生：

据悉，特别处于8月间曾就匈牙利国民 Janos MARK 一事向荷兰总领事馆进行查询。如蒙惠赐阁下关于此人报告的副本，不胜感激。能否确认其目前是否在上海？据我所知，他已于去年7月27日左右从曼谷启程前往上海。
荷兰总领事馆已善意地向我们提供了关于向 Mark 签发新护照的信息。

此致
敬礼，

护照管制官

R. W. Yorke 先生，
上海公共租界工部局警务处，
上海。

（批注：PA 17/9）
